overall: Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by giving inadequate notice of the December 14, 2011 job-performance topic and by deliberating by email on December 16, 2011; other allegations were rejected.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice failed to adequately describe the nature and purpose of a planned December 14, 2011 executive session.
allegations.key_passage: However, the Commission elected not to enter executive session, therefore there was no violation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission failed to give the airport manager written 48-hour notice before discussing him in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Commission never entered executive session under Purpose 1. Therefore, it was under no obligation to provide Mr. Guertin with written notice of its meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the meeting notice lacked sufficient detail about topics to be discussed; the job performance discussion was listed only as Operations.
allegations.key_passage: This broad category provided no detail to the public as to the nature of a topic that was clearly anticipated by the Chair

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission manipulated meeting notice topics to circumvent the 48-hour executive session notice requirement.
allegations.key_passage: However, we do not find evidence of any attempt to intentionally manipulate the notice to circumvent the law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged members deliberated outside an open meeting by email on contracts, documents and complaints before and after the December 14, 2011 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: A December 16, 2011 email exchange between all the members of the Commission clearly shows discussion on matters within the Commission's jurisdiction.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum discussed the manager's job performance before the December 14, 2011 meeting, so the open-session discussion was predetermined.
allegations.key_passage: We credit the Commission's assertion that a quorum of the Commission members did not discuss Mr. Guertin's job performance ahead of the Commission's December 14, 2011 meeting

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
Undergo Open Meeting Law training, certifying that every Commission member attended, within sixty (60) days of receipt of the letter.
Publicly release and disclose at the Commission's next meeting all emails referenced in the letter where the Commission engaged in deliberation in violation of the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: Publicly release and disclose at the Commission's next meeting all emails referenced in this letter where the Commission engaged in deliberation in violation of the Open Meeting Law.
